## EU Softens Battery Replacement Rule, Exempting Smartphones and Wearables While Pressuring E-Readers and Gaming Devices

A modest but clean positive for AAPL's hardware cost structure and a headwind for AMZN's Kindle line; worth tracking as EU hardware regulation increasingly differentiates obligations by product category.

- The EU revised its battery regulation to carve out exemptions for smartphones and wearables.
- Kindle (Amazon) and Nintendo devices are cited as facing compliance pressure under the updated rules.
- Apple's iPhone and wearable product lines benefit from the exemption.
- Regulatory divergence creates asymmetric compliance burdens across consumer electronics OEMs.
